summary: Hollander Electric is a family-run, master-licensed electrical and HVAC contractor based in East Brunswick, NJ, in business since 1988, whose stated primary focus is commercial and industrial electrical work (three-phase distribution, switchgear, motor controls, lighting controls, EV charging, standby power) with residential electrical and commercial HVAC as secondary offers. It advertises 24/7 emergency response for commercial and industrial clients, publishes 31 town landing pages aimed at central Jersey businesses, facility operators and homeowners, and holds a 4.8 Google rating from roughly 207 reviews. Its only web intake is a quote/request form plus call-or-text; there is no online scheduling, no published business hours and no owner name on the site.

facts.fact: Based in East Brunswick, NJ, family-run, and in business since 1988, serving Middlesex, Somerset and Mercer county communities.
Publishes four credentials sitewide: NJ Master Electrician Lic. #9674, NJ Master HVAC Lic. #4711, NJ Master HVAC Lic. #6091 and NJ Home Improvement Contractor #13VH02466500.

Site describes commercial and industrial electrical as the primary focus (service upgrades, three-phase distribution, panelboards/switchgear/transformers, lighting controls, generators, tenant fit-outs, EV charging) with residential electrical and commercial HVAC as added services.
Advertises 24/7 emergency response for commercial and industrial clients, and a same-business-day response on web quote requests.

Lists 31 town-specific landing pages (Milltown, East Brunswick, Edison, Old Bridge, Monroe, Princeton and others) and says it is 'on the road every day across Middlesex, Somerset, and Mercer county communities'.
Site states the business is rated 4.8 out of 5 across 208 Google reviews 'sourced from Hollander Electric's public Google Business listing'.

Google Business Profile for 'Hollander Electric' (category: Electrician) shows 4.8 stars from 207 reviews, phone (732) 940-0101, the website, status 'Closed · Opens 8 AM Mon', and attributes 'Language assistance' and 'LGBTQ+ friendly'.
Business-hours profiles list Mon-Fri 8:00 a.m.-4:30 p.m. (Birdeye shows Friday to 4:00 p.m.), closed Saturday and Sunday.
Contact channels published on the site are call or text 732-940-0101 and email toby@hollanderelectric.com; the site does not publish a street address or business hours.
Approved contractor on the National Energy Improvement Fund (NEIF) contractor list, with the JCP&L Energy Plus Home Improvement payment plan and commercial energy finance programs.
XML sitemap contains only the homepage (lastmod 2026-09-03) even though 31 town pages are linked from it.
Legacy .php URLs that still appear in search results (e.g. /residential.php) now return the same empty-title single-page app shell as the homepage.

operations_signals: Front door is call-or-text on 732-940-0101 (7 tel: links on the mobile Milltown page) plus three web forms; the two quote forms ask name, phone, service dropdown, town and a free-text 'how can we help?', and the contact form adds email (https://hollanderelectric.com/)

No online booking or slot selection anywhere: the strongest CTA is 'Request a Quote' / 'Request Service', with a 'Fast Response · Same Business Day' promise, so scoping every job needs a human callback (https://hollanderelectric.com/)

24/7 emergency response is advertised for commercial and industrial clients while the web form is business-hours/next-day in practice, so after-hours emergencies must arrive by phone (https://hollanderelectric.com/)
No business hours are published on the website; hours appear only in third-party profiles (Mon-Fri 8:00-4:30) (https://reviews.birdeye.com/hollander-electric-llc-889694528)

Owner-level phone handling is visible in customer accounts: a reviewer describes calling on a Friday and 'the owner answered, took my information' and booked a Monday visit (https://www.google.com/maps/place/Hollander+Electric/@40.4835935,-74.497676,10z/data=!4m8!3m7!1s0x89c3c4583c2a3431:0x5f303e8f28a7c110!8m2!3d40.4835935!4d-74.497676!9m1!1b1!16s%2Fg%2F1xg5tmkb)

Review responses are handled manually and continuously: nearly every visible Google review carries a short owner reply, some signed by a crew member (https://www.google.com/maps/place/Hollander+Electric/@40.4835935,-74.497676,10z/data=!4m8!3m7!1s0x89c3c4583c2a3431:0x5f303e8f28a7c110!8m2!3d40.4835935!4d-74.497676!9m1!1b1!16s%2Fg%2F1xg5tmkb)

The site is a single page: top nav has only in-page anchors (Services, Why Hollander, Service Areas, Contact), so there is no About, Services, Careers or Contact page to read (https://hollanderelectric.com/)

31 town pages are templated and carry visible copy defects where a town name was concatenated into a sentence ('soMilltown customers', 'Milltownbusinesses'), indicating bulk-generated pages rather than hand-edited content (https://hollanderelectric.com/electrician/milltown)
review_themes: Strong praise for responsiveness and punctuality: Google's own review topic chips group 'promptness' (9 mentions), 'courteous staff' (7), 'job completion time' (4) and 'detailed quote' (2) (https://www.google.com/maps/place/Hollander+Electric/@40.4835935,-74.497676,10z/data=!4m8!3m7!1s0x89c3c4583c2a3431:0x5f303e8f28a7c110!8m2!3d40.4835935!4d-74.497676!9m1!1b1!16s%2Fg%2F1xg5tmkb)

Long-tenure repeat customers are a repeated theme, with reviewers describing the same family using them for 15+ years and naming individual technicians (Josh, Toby, Steve) (https://www.google.com/maps/place/Hollander+Electric/@40.4835935,-74.497676,10z/data=!4m8!3m7!1s0x89c3c4583c2a3431:0x5f303e8f28a7c110!8m2!3d40.4835935!4d-74.497676!9m1!1b1!16s%2Fg%2F1xg5tmkb)

A review aggregator summary characterises the reviews as praising punctuality, communication, quality of work, clean-up, pricing and financing options for residential and HVAC jobs (https://www.bestprosintown.com/nj/east-brunswick/hollander-electric-llc-/)

The visible negative review is old (about 5 years) and disputes how a mistake was remediated; the owner publicly rejects it as fraudulent, which shows complaint handling is done personally in the review thread rather than through a ticketing process (https://www.google.com/maps/place/Hollander+Electric/@40.4835935,-74.497676,10z/data=!4m8!3m7!1s0x89c3c4583c2a3431:0x5f303e8f28a7c110!8m2!3d40.4835935!4d-74.497676!9m1!1b1!16s%2Fg%2F1xg5tmkb)

The negative side is thin rather than operational: in the reviews readable through the limited Google view there is no cluster of complaints about missed calls, no-shows or billing errors, and Google's topic chips are all service-quality labels (panel upgrade, generator installation, permit filing, breaker replacement, power line repair, outlet repair) (https://www.google.com/maps/place/Hollander+Electric/@40.4835935,-74.497676,10z/data=!4m8!3m7!1s0x89c3c4583c2a3431:0x5f303e8f28a7c110!8m2!3d40.4835935!4d-74.497676!9m1!1b1!16s%2Fg%2F1xg5tmkb)
tech_footprint: Built on Hostinger AI Builder: the served HTML is a Vite/React single-page shell (meta generator 'Hostinger AI Builder', /assets/index-*.js bundle) with no server-rendered content (https://hollanderelectric.com/)

Raw HTML <title> is empty, there is no meta description, and there are zero application/ld+json blocks on the home page despite full licence and town data being on-page (https://hollanderelectric.com/)
robots.txt is fully open ('User-agent: * / Allow: /') and points to a sitemap listing only the homepage (https://hollanderelectric.com/robots.txt)

Animated credential counters render as literal '0' until their JS animation runs, so '0 IN BUSINESS SINCE', '0 TOWNS SERVED' etc. are the first thing a text-only reader sees (https://hollanderelectric.com/electrician/milltown)
No booking widget, no chat widget, no visible CRM or dispatch integration on the page: conversion is three plain React forms plus tel: links (https://hollanderelectric.com/)
The '4.8 / 208 reviews' block on the site is static text, not a live Google review feed, though it links out to the Maps listing (https://hollanderelectric.com/)

Claimed Google Business Profile is actively maintained: owner-added photos dated two days before this check, plus owner replies on reviews (https://www.google.com/maps/place/Hollander+Electric/@40.4835935,-74.497676,10z/data=!4m8!3m7!1s0x89c3c4583c2a3431:0x5f303e8f28a7c110!8m2!3d40.4835935!4d-74.497676!9m1!1b1!16s%2Fg%2F1xg5tmkb)
Claimed Birdeye review profile (aggregating 265 reviews across sources, 4.8), which implies a review-management tool is in use (https://reviews.birdeye.com/hollander-electric-llc-889694528)
Listed as an approved NEIF contractor with a contractor portal for financing applications and JCP&L rebate-linked payment plans (https://www.neifund.org/hollander-electric-llc/)
growth_signals: Site appears recently rebuilt and expanded: the 31 town pages are live but the sitemap carries a single homepage entry lastmod 2026-09-03, suggesting a relaunch around September 2026 (https://hollanderelectric.com/sitemap.xml)

Marketing scope has widened from a legacy .php site (residential.php, generator.php, inspection.php, edison-nj.php and similar URLs still indexed) to a single-page site with town landing pages aimed at commercial, industrial and residential searches (https://hollanderelectric.com/residential.php)

Offers NEIF/JCP&L-backed financing and a preventive-maintenance program for industrial facilities, which points to recurring contract work rather than one-off jobs (https://www.neifund.org/hollander-electric-llc/)

No news coverage, awards, new locations or press releases were found for the last 12 months in the sources checked; the Patch business listing only repeats the service description (https://patch.com/new-jersey/eastbrunswick/business/listing/594789/hollander-electric)
physical_signals: Business base is East Brunswick, NJ; the site gives the town only and publishes no street address, shop or yard details (https://hollanderelectric.com/)
Third-party profiles list the business address as 28 Henry Street, East Brunswick, NJ 08816 (not confirmed on an owned page) (https://reviews.birdeye.com/hollander-electric-llc-889694528)

Work is field-based across Middlesex, Somerset and Mercer counties with crews described as 'on the road every day'; no fleet size, warehouse, dock or square footage is published (https://hollanderelectric.com/)

Team appears small and family-based: reviewers refer to 'Josh and dad' and to Steve, Toby and Josh as the people who do the work, and no staff count is published on the site (https://www.google.com/maps/place/Hollander+Electric/@40.4835935,-74.497676,10z/data=!4m8!3m7!1s0x89c3c4583c2a3431:0x5f303e8f28a7c110!8m2!3d40.4835935!4d-74.497676!9m1!1b1!16s%2Fg%2F1xg5tmkb)

Job types are commercial/industrial sites (office, retail and restaurant fit-outs, plants, switchgear and motor-control rooms) plus residential homes; Google review topics include panel upgrade, generator installation, permit filing, breaker replacement and power line repair (https://www.google.com/maps/place/Hollander+Electric/@40.4835935,-74.497676,10z/data=!4m8!3m7!1s0x89c3c4583c2a3431:0x5f303e8f28a7c110!8m2!3d40.4835935!4d-74.497676!9m1!1b1!16s%2Fg%2F1xg5tmkb)
decision_maker: Unknown — the business's own site and Google profile publish no owner name or title; the public contact mailbox is toby@hollanderelectric.com and Google reviewers refer to 'Steve Hollander' and 'Toby' without stating roles (https://hollanderelectric.com/)

inferences.inference: The owner is likely the primary intake and dispatch point, not a receptionist or answering service.
inferences.reasoning: A reviewer describes the owner personally answering a Friday call and booking the visit; the only published mailbox is a first-name address (toby@); reviews name the same few people (Steve, Toby, Josh) doing the work; and a LinkedIn company snippet reports 2-10 employees (that page could not be opened, so headcount is unverified).

inferences.inference: After-hours emergency work is captured by mobile phone only, so calls that arrive when nobody answers probably become lost or next-day jobs.
inferences.reasoning: The site advertises 24/7 emergency response for commercial and industrial clients, but the web channel is a same-business-day form with no after-hours triage, no published hours, and no callback/SLA text beyond 'for emergencies, call 732-940-0101'.

inferences.inference: The 31 town pages generate little search or AI-answer traffic despite good on-page structure.
inferences.reasoning: Every page serves an empty <title>, has no meta description and no JSON-LD, the sitemap lists only the homepage, and legacy .php URLs still indexed by search engines now resolve to the same shell — so the machine-readable layer is missing even though the copy is thorough.

inferences.inference: Quote requests arriving through the web form need manual scoping before they can become scheduled work, which is the main coordination cost.
inferences.reasoning: The form captures only name, phone, optional email, town, a service dropdown and free text; there is no service address, panel/service size, access window, permit or urgency field, and no calendar handoff.

inferences.inference: Recurring commercial and industrial work (preventive maintenance, 24/7 response, generator and switchgear service) likely produces a steady stream of scheduling, reminder and follow-up tasks handled by hand.
inferences.reasoning: The site sells preventive-maintenance programs and 24/7 response to facilities, while the visible toolset is a marketing site plus a review platform — no field-service or dispatch software is exposed anywhere public.

data_gaps: No current or recent job postings found: the site has no careers page, Indeed blocked this session (Cloudflare 'Request Blocked'), LinkedIn, Angi, BBB, YellowPages and BuildZoom all returned HTTP 403, and searches for Hollander Electric openings on job boards came back empty.
Hiring signals section therefore left empty rather than guessed.
Owner/decision-maker name and title could not be verified on an owned page; BBB reportedly lists a president and LinkedIn names employees, but neither page could be opened.

No street address, hours, fleet size, headcount, square footage or yard details are published by the business itself; the 28 Henry Street address comes only from third-party profiles and is unverified.
BuildZoom permit history (commercial service upgrades at Route 18 and Old Stage Road addresses) appeared in search snippets but the page was blocked, so no permit records are recorded here.
OSHA establishment search, NJ state contractor-licence lookup and municipal permit portals were not queried; no local health-inspection or building-permit data was retrieved.
Google review text was read only through the limited Maps view (about 8 of 207 reviews) plus Birdeye and BestProsInTown aggregations, so review themes rest on a small sample.
Angi and BBB review counts/ratings could not be verified directly (HTTP 403).
